candidate.title: DeepSeek R1 Explained - A fascinating LLM AI!
candidate.description:
DeepSeek R1 in an open-source AI Model. It is very good at reasoning and was trained with Reinforcement Learning. It uses Mixture-of-Experts Architecture. In this video I feed it three questions including can we travel at light speed in the future?

Thank you for the ever-growing support and I wish you all the best on your AI learning journey. - Sheppe

00:00 Mixture-of-Experts Approach
01:54 Reinforcement Learning
03:22 Testing Prompts
04:43 Create a Study Guide for Computer Architecture
07:14 Asking can we eventually travel the speed of light?
12:17 Creating a card game similar to Pokemon
